tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Check whether a site's robots.txt allows or blocks each known AI crawler (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and about thirty others), with the exact rule and line that decided it.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Fetch and validate a site's llms.txt: findings with severity and line numbers, a 0 to 100 score, section and entry counts, whether the linked URLs resolve, and whether a sibling llms-full.txt exists.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Crawl a site and generate an llms.txt. depth "index" produces the link index (up to 30 pages); depth "full" produces llms-full.txt with extracted page content (up to 20 pages).

tools.name: generate_sitemap
tools.description: Crawl a site (up to 200 pages, sitemap-first with a link-following fallback) and return a valid sitemap.xml, with lastmod only where it was genuinely observed.

tools.name: analyze_content_chunking
tools.description: Analyze how well a page is chunked for retrieval: per-heading sections with word and token counts, findings by severity, strengths, a score and the top fixes.

tools.name: validate_structured_data
tools.description: Fetch a page, validate its JSON-LD entities against the schema.org types that matter for AI visibility, and report per-entity findings with severity, entity counts and a score. Also reports how many microdata and RDFa annotations are present, without validating them.

tools.name: check_meta_description
tools.description: Analyze a page's title, meta description, og:description and opening paragraph: character and pixel widths, where desktop and mobile truncate, a score and per-check findings.
